166    private function tenantContextFromToken(Employee $employee): ?array
167    {
168        $token = $employee->currentAccessToken();
169        $rawAbilities = rescue(static fn (): mixed => $token->abilities, [], false);
170        $rawAbilities = is_array($rawAbilities) ? $rawAbilities : [];
171        $abilities = array_values(array_filter($rawAbilities, static fn (mixed $ability): bool => is_string($ability)));
172
173        $schema = $this->abilityValue($abilities, 'tenant_schema:');
174        $email = $this->abilityValue($abilities, 'tenant_email:');
175        $companyId = $this->abilityValue($abilities, 'tenant_company:');
176        $employeeId = $this->abilityValue($abilities, 'tenant_employee:');
177
178        if (! $schema || ! $email || ! $companyId || ! $employeeId || ! $this->isSafeSchemaName($schema)) {
179            return null;
180        }
181
182        return [
183            'schema' => $schema,
184            'email' => $email,
185            'company_id' => $companyId,
186            'employee_id' => (int) $employeeId,
187        ];
188    }

190    /**
191     * @param  list<string>  $abilities
192     */
193    private function abilityValue(array $abilities, string $prefix): ?string
194    {
195        foreach ($abilities as $ability) {
196            if (str_starts_with($ability, $prefix)) {
197                return substr($ability, strlen($prefix));
198            }
199        }
200
201        return null;
202    }

255    private function replaceRequestUser(Employee $originalEmployee, Employee $tenantEmployee, Request $request): Employee
256    {
257        rescue(

261        );
